title: The Hollow of Ashvale
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Hazel Sterling, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
